description: Local-first Claude Solace. Sized so a Q4_K_M GGUF fits comfortably under a 16 GB system-RAM cap with full native context. Hybrid Gemma-4-style + GPT-OSS architecture: GQA, GeGLU, QK-norm, pre+post RMSNorm sandwich, sliding-window attention alternated with full attention, dual RoPE base, attention sinks for streaming.

deployment.notes: Ship BF16 safetensors for HF + GGUF Q4_K_M for llama.cpp/Ollama. Sliding-window attention bounds the KV cache for 5/6 of layers, so total runtime memory at full 32k context is ~6-7 GB.
